title: AmCham links Taiwan, China on WTO - Taipei Times
content:
In contrast to previous years, when the American Chamber of Commerce in Taipei's (
AmCham president Paul Cassingham's (
AmCham will be sending a team to the US capital to meet with members of the Senate, House of Representatives and senior officials in various departments of the Clinton administration, from Sept. 13 to 16.
"WTO accession for Taiwan has been our priority for the past several years," Cassingham said. "For many years we have advocated that Taiwan's entry should not be linked to the PRC's application." However, this year, Cassingham said, both Taiwan and China's entry into WTO was supported on the economic merits of both cases, and "the US should support the PRC's entry into the WTO on the same basis, provided it does not jeapordize Taiwan's application."
"It is important for Taiwan to participate in the multilateral talks in Seattle in November this year, but for Taiwan to partici-pate, it must first be admitted," Cassingham said. "We recognize it would be easier if it were admitted at the same time as the PRC ... we believe it is important that the PRC is not in a position to block Taiwan's accession."
AmCham would accord second priority to increasing Taiwan's membership of international organizations, like the World Health Organization, World Customs Organization, International Monetary Fund, and World Bank, Cassingham said. As Taiwan is not recognized as a state by most of these organizations, AmCham will advocate that the US government should actively support the removal of the statehood requirement for membership in these organizations.
A further priority is the encouragement of visits to Taiwan by US Cabinet officials. "A few have visited -- but frankly not very many, " said Cassingham. "We would like more. If these visits are more regular they will become less sensitive." Cassingham also said the encouragement of peaceful cross-strait development was a further priority issue. "The US should display sensitivity and consistency in its policies toward Taiwan and China," he said. Asked whether this statement indicated that the US had recently been showing a lack of consistency, he said, "The political relationship is a matter to be resolved by the governments of Beijing and Taipei."
AmCham also "encouraged the US to support Taiwan, as provided in the Taiwan Relations Act and in recognition of Taiwan as an open and democratic society."
The press conference also provided a forum for discussion of AmCham's latest White Paper, which was released to the public last week. In recent days local media has carried extensive commentary on the subject -- in particular, Schive Chi (
In response, AmCham stressed that the CEPD had been extensively involved in discussions of draft versions of the paper, reviewed in August, and that the divergence in apparent viewpoints between AmCham and the CEPD was because many issues had been resolved in principle, but not yet implemented. As an example, Cassingham quoted the government regulations for foreign investment limits on fixed telecommunications, where the Executive Yuan had agreed in principle that the limit should be raised to 60 percent, but that the relevant amendment had yet to be passed.
Asked whether local press reaction showed that the White Paper had been overly politicized, Cassingham said that the situation had changed over the past few years, and the paper was now seen as more a business matter, and less a political one. "We view the White Paper as a contribution to public policy discourse," he said, adding that he hoped the media would recognize it as such. As to the extensive political commentary contained in the White Paper, he pointed out that the main function of the commentary and analysis was to provide a summary of local events for the overseas head offices of members' companies. "The individual position papers are aimed at government officials," he added.

title: Net trading hurts the little guys - Taipei Times
content:
Internet trading over the first eight months of the year has caused a massive reshuffle in the the market share of hundreds of Taiwan securities brokerages. Several brokerages which have focused more on Internet trading and opened more branches have seen their market share rise. They include Polaris (
The growing influence of the Internet trading market led to President launching an Internet trading packages and zero commission rate program in early September. In response, many other brokerages have launched similar Internet trading programs which, according to analysts, are likely to have a significant impact on the brokerage market in the coming months. According to Lin Ming-sing (
Moreover, with large securities companies developing Internet trading services so as to expand their market share, many small brokerages are likely to face difficulties in the near future. Without the resources to develop Internet trading services, many of them will have to withdraw from the market. There is also likely to be another wave of mergers and acquisitions at the end of the year.
According to the Taiwan Stock Exchange, the market share of each of the four largest brokerages at the end of 1998 was above three percent; and the share of a further 11 brokerages was between two and three percent. Between January and August this year, the six largest brokerages each occupied more than three percent of the market share; meanwhile, the number of brokerages with between two and three percent market share decreased to seven firms.
With the number of brokerages with a market share of two percent or more decreasing over the past eight months from 15 to 13, the figures demonstrate the increasing difficulty for brokerages to climb into, or maintain, their position among Taiwan's top ten. As the big get bigger, the special offers rolled out recently by several of the major firms -- including a free personal computer and other gifts to customers who sign up now for Internet trading -- has simply furthered this movement.
President Securities, for example, won 10,000 new customers in the first three days of its latest promotion activity last week. Executives from the firm estimates that it could attract 50,000 to 100,000 new customers during the month. If the estimates are accurate, President's program will result in other brokerages losing customers simply because they can't afford to launch a program costing up to NT$1 billion. With several other large brokerages have been introducing similar programs over the past few days, the competition will only intensify, and small brokerages will see their number of customers continue to dwindle.
The fast-growing percentage of Internet trading will be critical to many of the smaller brokerages. The market share of most brokerages in Taiwan is less than one percent -- the 20th largest has a share of 1.02 percent. As a result, if the market volume of Internet trading were to increase over the next five years from just over 3 percent of overall volume at present to a figure near the current US Internet market volume of 25 to 30 percent, dozens of brokerages which are unable to offer Internet trading services could be forced to close.
Of the more than 1,000 securities brokerage head offices and branches in Taiwan at present, most continue to operate using more traditional means, either face-to-face or by telephone trading. With the trading volume of the market in the first eight months of the year standing at NT$2.88 trillion, one percent of that figure would equal NT$28.8 billion.
The brokerage commission generated from one percent of market share is around NT$40 million before rebates. But for hundreds of brokerages, their market share is under 0.5 percent, since the top 20 brokerages occupy 50 percent of the market. The other 50 percent of the market is shared by 200 smaller brokerages. So every small brokerage occupies on average 0.25 percent of the market.
Based on the NT$2.88 trillion trading volume, many brokerages therefore earned less than N$10 million in the first eight months of the year, with a capitalization of NT$200 million.

title: India must aim higher: cost optimization must not define the country’s tryst with artificial intelligence | Mint
content:
When DeepSeek released the preview of its V4 model on 24 April 2026, the contrast with the rest of the AI industry could not have been starker (tinyurl.com/4d6uauvn).
The Pro variant is priced below Claude Opus 4.7, GPT-5.5 and Gemini 3.1 Pro, and the Flash variant undercuts every smaller frontier model. Further, it is open-source and runs on domestic Chinese chips from Huawei and Cambricon, showing the world that Nvidia’s chokehold on the AI hardware space is not absolute.
In the same week, Anthropic users hit Claude Code usage caps faster than expected, OpenAI scaled back Sora to redirect compute towards core services and Datadog reported nearly 60% of AI failures in production now trace back to capacity limits (tinyurl.com/yc8s5jdr). A Chinese competitor is offering something almost as good, fully open-source and open-weight, and cheaper by an order of magnitude.
The rest of us should be worried.
Costs have always been the ground on which vendors or firms compete, and that matters more in AI than their capability on benchmark tests. For the enterprise buyer trying to capitalize on latent demand for its services and boost productivity, raw frontier capability is not the binding consideration; it is the price per token.
Most firms do not need ‘Opus-grade’ reasoning to summarize a meeting, schedule executive meetings, handle customer service or run a basic agentic workflow. What they need is a ‘good enough’ tool that scales cheaper than hiring labour for those tasks.
This was China’s playbook in manufacturing; it has been brought to AI. Chinese manufacturers scaled up by supplying ‘good enough’ products at floor prices, eventually pushing competitors out of the market. Now, they are releasing capable models for free, setting the price floor and letting the market do the rest.
Even those who won’t deploy Chinese models for security reasons will use DeepSeek’s pricing to negotiate with Western providers. The pricing pressure will do its work.
These developments matter for India in ways the price tag on foreign AI services don’t capture.
India keeps its markets relatively open and does not ban services from any particular country, giving buyers a wide range of choice. With Chinese models getting cost-effective, it is likely that India’s private firms will reach for the most cost-effective option, making ‘indigenous’ options unattractive.
The incentive for Indian firms to invest in foundational AI research, already thin given the stiff competition they face from Western model providers with deep pockets, fades further with each release. If the world’s cheapest capable model is open-weight and Chinese, the business case for an Indian foundation model fails even before it can be made.
Few venture investors will fund a firm building a domestic frontier model when an almost-frontier alternative can be downloaded free. The talent that might have done that work will leave for firms abroad that are still investing in pre-training, or will get redirected to building applications on top of someone else’s model. Neither produces the foundational expertise that could turn a country from a customer into an AI leader.
The deeper cost is harder to see on a profit-and-loss statement. Free trade and the pursuit of cheap goods delivered enormous benefits, but they also concentrated ‘implicit knowledge’ in the places that did the work.
This is the kind of know-how that most don’t appreciate. It is the engineer who can tell by feel how many millimetres the drill needs to be adjusted, the team that has debugged software at scale enough times to predict where it will fail, the operator who has maintained a fab clean-room long enough to know which procedures cannot be cut. You acquire this by doing the work repeatedly at scale, not by reading about it.
Manufacturing know-how has not settled in China by accident and today there is barely a domain of modern manufacturing where China does not command both underlying knowledge and a cost advantage. Reshoring out of strategic necessity is not impossible, but it takes far longer than the timelines that policy incentives assume because a knowledge base has to be built by people who have never done such work. In that gap, the lead only widens. The same logic now applies to AI.
There is also no ecosystem effect for the importer. In complex systems, one capability seeds another. A country with foundation model labs develops a downstream pipeline of fine-tuning specialists, evaluation researchers, agent infrastructure firms, safety teams and inference optimisation startups, because each of these depends on engineers close to the actual work. If we strip out the foundation, the chain does not even begin to form. We end up with the integration layer alone, forever a customer.
The economics of that position has been kind to us in the past. It is unlikely to be as kind in an era of shifting geopolitics, though.
AI differs as an arena from manufacturing, which is why we should act now. Manufacturing shifted bases over decades. The AI stack is still being built, applications are being defined and implicit knowledge is being formed.
The window in which a country can take a strategic stance, before dependence becomes permanent, is narrow. Tooling, agent frameworks, evaluation suites, fine-tuning pipelines and research infrastructure get built around whichever models become the default.
Once Chinese open-weight models run inside India’s enterprises, the surrounding ecosystem will grow around them and switching costs will become structural rather than financial.
It is time to let go of the notion that everything must be optimized solely on the basis of costs and short-term profitability. It may be ‘cheap’ in the short run, but can prove costly in the long run. Intangibles such as implicit knowledge and strategic indispensability don’t show up in quarterly reports, but their benefit to firms and the country create long-term dividends.
The private sector needs to recognize this.
Firms foraying into AI need to raise their research and development budgets and focus on building foundational AI capabilities rather than relying on imported solutions. Such investments need to be measured not against profit statements but rather against everything India may not be able to do in 10 years if we optimize only for what we monetarily save today.
These are the authors’ personal views.
The authors are, respectively, chief economic advisor to the Government of India, and consultant, ministry of finance.

‘Los grupos armados estarían promoviendo la inscripción de cédulas de cara al proceso presidencial’: gobernadora del Meta
En diálogo con EL TIEMPO, la gobernadora Rafaela Cortés habla de la situación de seguridad en el marco de las elecciones.
Hay consternación en el departamento del Meta por el asesinato a sangre fría del exalcalde de Cubarral (Meta), Rogers Mauricio Devia Escobar, quien fue baleado mientras regresaba a su municipio tras hacer proselitismo en favor del candidato presidencial Abelardo de la Espriella. La víctima era el coordinador de la campaña de este último en Cubarral y fue fusilado junto a uno de sus acompañantes, Eder Fabián Cardona. La situación encendió las alertas por los niveles de violencia política en el país y obligaron a las autoridades a desarrollar un consejo extraordinario de seguridad. Para saber más de la situación, EL TIEMPO contactó a la gobernadora Rafaela Cortés.
¿Qué hipótesis manejan las autoridades con respecto a la posible autoría del asesinato de Rogers Mauricio Devia?
En este momento, las autoridades competentes —la Fiscalía General de la Nación, junto con la SIJIN, el CTI y los organismos de inteligencia— están concentradas en el desarrollo de la investigación bajo estricta reserva procesal.
Lo responsable en este tipo de casos es no especular sobre hipótesis ni atribuir responsabilidades sin el soporte técnico y judicial correspondiente. Lo que sí podemos afirmar es que existe un equipo especial de investigación trabajando de manera articulada, con todas las capacidades del Estado desplegadas para avanzar con rapidez en la identificación de los autores materiales e intelectuales.
El compromiso de esta administración es claro: no habrá impunidad.
¿Con qué garantías cuentan los actores políticos para desempeñar su papel en estas elecciones presidenciales en el Meta?
Hoy el Meta cuenta con un esquema reforzado de seguridad institucional precisamente orientado a proteger el ejercicio democrático. En el Consejo Extraordinario de Seguridad se definió el fortalecimiento de operaciones conjuntas entre Ejército y Policía, el incremento de patrullajes en corredores estratégicos y zonas rurales, el refuerzo de inteligencia y el monitoreo permanente de riesgos asociados a liderazgos políticos, sociales y comunitarios.
Adicionalmente, se ha dispuesto un esquema de articulación permanente con la Fiscalía y los organismos electorales para garantizar condiciones de seguridad, movilidad y presencia institucional en todo el territorio.
Asimismo, desde el departamento se reiteró el llamado al Gobierno Nacional y a las entidades competentes para fortalecer y revisar oportunamente las medidas de protección y acompañamiento a candidatos, liderazgos políticos y sociales que puedan enfrentar situaciones de riesgo durante el proceso electoral.
El mensaje es claro: el Estado está presente y acompañado, y el proceso electoral se va a proteger con toda la capacidad institucional disponible.
¿Ha conocido episodios de constreñimiento al sufragante por parte de organizaciones criminales en estas elecciones presidenciales?
Sí existen alertas y hechos que generan preocupación y que están siendo objeto de seguimiento por parte de las autoridades. La Gobernación del Meta y el Ejército Nacional han reconocido situaciones en las que estructuras armadas ilegales estarían adelantando procesos de carnetización de personas en algunos sectores, como una forma de ejercer control territorial, identificar quién permanece en determinadas zonas y monitorear quién entra y quién sale del territorio.
Adicionalmente, hemos conocido la circulación de panfletos atribuidos a grupos armados ilegales en los que se estaría promoviendo la inscripción de cédulas de cara al proceso presidencial. Ese tipo de mensajes y presiones generan preocupación y pueden interpretarse como una forma de constreñimiento e intimidación alrededor del escenario electoral.
¿Tienden a privilegiar algún candidato particular?
Hasta el momento, las autoridades no han establecido que exista orientación directa hacia un candidato específico, y precisamente por eso las investigaciones y labores de inteligencia continúan avanzando. Lo más importante es que el Estado está actuando de manera preventiva y articulada para garantizar que ningún actor ilegal interfiera con la libertad del voto ni con las garantías democráticas de los ciudadanos.
¿Qué hará la gobernación del Meta, en articulación con las autoridades, para garantizar unas elecciones libres?
La Gobernación del Meta, en articulación con la Fuerza Pública, la Fiscalía y los organismos de inteligencia, ha definido un paquete integral de medidas que combina presencia territorial, capacidad operativa y tecnología.
Entre las acciones principales se encuentran: El fortalecimiento de operaciones conjuntas en corredores estratégicos y zonas priorizadas. El incremento de patrullajes, controles viales y presencia permanente en municipios con alertas de seguridad. El refuerzo de capacidades de inteligencia e investigación criminal. El uso de herramientas tecnológicas adquiridas por la Gobernación para seguimiento de riesgos y apoyo a la judicialización.
También se cuenta con la entrega de 12 motocicletas al Ejército Nacional para mejorar movilidad y reacción en zonas rurales. La articulación permanente con las autoridades nacionales y organismos competentes frente a las necesidades de protección y acompañamiento para candidatos, liderazgos políticos y comunidades durante el proceso electoral.
A esto se suma la consolidación del plan de recompensas de la Gobernación del Meta, que ha demostrado ser una herramienta efectiva para apoyar la acción de las autoridades, incentivar la denuncia ciudadana y fortalecer la lucha contra la criminalidad en el departamento, en articulación con la Fuerza Pública y los municipios.
El objetivo es garantizar algo esencial: que la ciudadanía pueda ejercer su derecho al voto en libertad, sin miedo y con plena confianza institucional.

content:
NEW DELHI: Under the “Mera Bharat Mera Yogdan” campaign aimed at promoting fuel conservation, Delhi Chief Minister Rekha Gupta, along with her cabinet ministers and senior government officials, travelled by Metro to office on Monday.
Gupta boarded the Metro from Kashmere Gate station on the Violet Line near her Jan Sewa Sadan residence on Raj Niwas Marg. She was accompanied by Social Welfare Minister Ravindra Singh Indraj, and the team travelled together to ITO station near the Delhi Secretariat, according to news agency PTI.
"I want to urge all Delhi residents to use public transport, which will not only save fuel but also help fighting pollution and traffic jams. Delhi government is working to strengthen public transport and remove last-mile connectivity issues," she told reporters at ITO metro station.
Several cabinet ministers, including Ashish Sood, Manjinder Singh Sirsa, Kapil Mishra, and Pankaj Singh, also opted for Metro travel to reach their respective destinations.
Transport Minister Pankaj Singh travelled by
Delhi Metro to Ram Krishna Ashram Marg station as part of the government’s “Monday Metro” initiative.
Environment Minister Manjinder Singh Sirsa also used the Metro to reach the Delhi Secretariat.
The Delhi government has announced a series of measures including two-day work-from-home for employees, “no car day,” virtual meetings, and reduced use of official vehicles, as part of nationwide efforts to conserve petroleum products amid uncertainties in West Asia.

title: Apple Is Making Hit Products and High Profits From Imperfect Chips | Mint
content:
Apple, long revered for its premium-priced products, has managed to develop a booming business selling cheaper devices when most gadget makers are being hammered by rising costs.
One of its secrets: using chips with slight defects that might otherwise be thrown out.
The strategy is apparent in the technical minutiae of the newly released $599 MacBook Neo, which early data suggest is a hit with customers.
The chip powering the Neo is Apple’s A18 Pro, the same chip first used inside the iPhone 16 Pro two years ago, but with one key difference. The Neo version of the chip has a “5-core” graphics processor, one less than the version inside the 2024 iPhones, indicating that Apple was able to save some of the A18 Pro chips with a defective core for future use.

title: National Assembly deputies deserve fairer treatment - Taipei Times
content:
The National Assembly has just passed several amendments to the Constitution. These include cutting the number of National Assembly deputies from 300 to 150, extending the date on future Assembly elections, and appointing deputies to the Assembly by way of a proportional representation system.
After the first direct presidential election and the streamlining of the Taiwan Provincial Government, these changes represent another significant milestone in the history of Taiwan's constitutional reforms.
The National Assembly's speaker Su Nan-cheng (蘇南成) has had a keen insight into the reform process and has shown resolution in his determination to carry it through. He should be credited with the success of the constitutional reforms.
But rather than receive bouquets from the public for his performance, he has felt only brickbats. When it comes to reform in Taiwan, the public continue to be misinformed and judge accordingly.
Thanks to biased media coverage, most people consider the reforms as reflecting the Assembly's obsession with self-interest.
By calling the deputies "shameless," "betraying and humiliating the country," and "defying the laws and regulations," the public have simply followed the media's lead. Few have tried to understand the substance of the reforms.
Certain elements of the reforms do need to be questioned, but the overall package is designed as a temporary measure to respond to the situation in the next two years. What is needed is long-term reform of the National Assembly.
The term extension should be considered as a cheap way of achieving that.
Even during the reign of the former president Chiang Ching-kuo (蔣經國), when KMT party discipline was much stricter than it is today, the government had to offer handsome pension programs to ask the old National Assembly deputies and legislators to retire. Today, the party has almost no hold over the National Assembly.
Some critics are calling for the abolition of the Assembly, but they should look to the example of the downsizing of the Taiwan Provincial Government for reasons not to.
The downsizing of the provincial government divided the KMT and caused unrest in society.
In comparison, granting the deputies two more years of tenure is not too expensive a price to pay.
Therefore, the term extension plan is one of the constitutional reforms that will cost the least to society.
This round of constitutional reforms also results in a reduction in the number of National Assembly deputies, fewer elections, and more experts to take part in future constitutional reforms.
This all helps stabilize the society and develop the country.
In the tiny island of Taiwan, a Constitution has to be drawn up to represent 36 provinces.
That is an almost impossible task, so amendments can not be avoided. But every time an amendment is made, it becomes a struggle between laws and party interests; and causes written and oral polemics.
The public and the media all pay too much attention to the process of reform, rather than the reform itself.

title: 李洋關心亞運棒球培訓藍白賽 王政浩後援拿投手MVP | 運動 | 中央社 CNA
content:
李洋關心亞運棒球培訓藍白賽 王政浩後援拿投手MVP
（中央社記者謝靜雯台北18日電）亞運棒球項目培訓隊藍白對抗賽第3戰，白隊投手王政浩後援投3局無失分、拿下投手MVP，吳松勳1安2打點、為打者MVP；運動部長李洋今天也到場關心培訓隊備戰。
備戰2026年名古屋亞運，棒球項目40人培訓名單出爐後安排藍白對抗賽，由總教練湯登凱領軍，比賽安排在高雄國家訓練中心舉行，李洋今天也到場關心培訓隊備戰狀況。
今天第3戰白隊開賽就有攻勢，陳孝允二壘打幫助球隊先馳得點，靠著保送、林雨力敲安添分；再靠著滾地球、保送，吳松勳適時安打，一棒送回2分，取得4比0領先。
白隊3局下再抓準對方投手控球有狀況，單局5次四壞保送、暴投，1支安打都沒有就拿下2分；9局下邱郡敲出二壘打，靠著滾地球、保送、王騰玉適時安打，送回球隊第7分，終場就以7比4拿勝。
藍隊4局上靠著黃柏叡二壘打、滾地球推進、暴投追回1分，6局黃柏叡安打再追1分，楊振裕安打添分，再靠著高飛犧牲打再跑回第4分，但比賽後半段沒有多添分數吞敗。
白隊先發投手郭定泓總計投3局被敲出2支安打，投出2次三振、無失分、無關勝敗；郭子銓接替登板，中繼投3局被敲出4支安打，投出4K，失掉4分責失分。
白隊王政浩7局後援登板，投3局讓對手9上9下，投出1次三振、無失分，替球隊守住勝利，郭子銓拿下勝投，王政浩獲選投手MVP。（編輯：陳仁華）1150518

Cancillería de Bolivia rechaza las declaraciones del presidente Gustavo Petro sobre su situación interna: 'No reflejan la relación de amistad'
La entidad del país suramericano se pronunció después de que el mandatario colombiano escribiera en su cuenta de X.
Este domingo 17 de abril, sobre las 8:30 de la noche, la Cancillería de Bolivia publicó un comunicado refiriéndose a las recientes declaraciones del presidente Gustavo Petro, el cual aseguró que "Bolivia vive una insurrección popular" en medio de la situación interna del país.
La entidad del país latinoamericano resaltó que estas situaciones se deben manejar con "el respeto a las instituciones democráticas y mediante mecanismos de diálogo" exclusivos de Bolivia sin interferencias externas.
Mediante un comunicado publicado en su cuenta de X, la Cancillería afirmó que los dos países tienen buenas relaciones y que esas posiciones no representan el debido respeto a la independencia del país.
"El Estado Plurinacional de Bolivia expresa su rechazo a las declaraciones formuladas por el Presidente de la República de Colombia, Gustavo Petro, respecto a la situación interna boliviana", añadió la entidad.
Además, aseguraron que esos mensajes no están acordes a las relaciones entre los países: "Dichas declaraciones no reflejan la relación de amistad, respeto y cooperación entre los pueblos de Bolivia y Colombia, ni los profundos vínculos históricos que unen a ambos Estados".
Con respecto a la independencia del país, señalaron que: "Bolivia considera improcedente cualquier interpretación o caracterización externa que distorsione la naturaleza de los acontecimientos actuales o que contribuya a profundizar la confrontación entre bolivianos. El Gobierno del Estado Plurinacional de Bolivia reafirma que los desafíos actuales deben ser resueltos en el marco del orden constitucional, el respeto a las instituciones democráticas y mediante mecanismos de diálogo que corresponden exclusivamente al pueblo boliviano".
"Las transformaciones que Bolivia requiere, luego de casi veinte años de tensiones políticas, deterioro institucional y problemas estructurales acumulados, deben ser impulsadas por los propios bolivianos, en paz, con responsabilidad democrática y pleno respeto a su soberanía", añadió el comunicado.
Por último, la entidad recalcó la importancia del respeto y la independencia: "Asimismo, Bolivia recuerda la importancia del respeto al principio de no injerencia en los asuntos internos de los Estados, conforme al Derecho Internacional y a los principios que rigen las relaciones entre países de América Latina y el Caribe. El Estado Plurinacional de Bolivia ratifica su compromiso con la paz social, la estabilidad democrática y la búsqueda de soluciones pacíficas e institucionales".
— Cancillería de Bolivia 🇧🇴 (@MRE_Bolivia) May 18, 2026
Declaraciones del presidente Petro
El mensaje que motivó este comunicado fue publicado ese mismo día sobre las 12 de la tarde, en el cual el presidente aseguró que "Bolivia vive una insurrección popular".
El mandatario agregó que estos hechos son "la respuesta a la soberbia geopolítica". Y enfatizó en que: "Latinoamérica es una civilización diversa y diferente, no se le puede homogeneizar desde ningún lado del planeta. Latinoamérica y el Caribe deben ser escuchados por el mundo mirando de frente en paz, y hablando con franqueza".
Además, añadió su disposición para ayudar en el conflicto: "Mi gobierno está dispuesto, si es invitado, a buscar fórmulas pacíficas de salida a la crisis política boliviana. No debe haber presos políticos en ninguna parte de las Américas, debemos construir una democracia profunda, multicolor en nuestra civilización que viene de 60.000 años en las Américas, pero también viene del Mediterráneo ancestral y del África negra y de los desiertos del Sahara".
Para finalizar, el presidente añadió una anécdota sobre el mandatario de ese país: "En Panamá hablé con el presidente de Bolivia sobre su padre Paz Zamora, el primer progresismo latinoamericano y su paso por Bogotá y Panamá en el exilio, donde recibió las visitas del general Torrijos y del M19 con Carlos Vidales, el hijo del poeta".
Y añadió: "Que ese recuerdo lo llene hoy de amor por su pueblo y abra el diálogo para transformar a Bolivia en una democracia cada vez más profunda y soberana, profundamente latinoamericana".
Bolivia vive una insurrección popular.

title: Kyiv Enters a Hopeful Spring After Surviving the War’s Darkest Winter | Mint
content:
It was the middle of January when the cold and lack of electricity forced Olha Kosova and her baby to flee their Kyiv apartment to her parents’ place in the suburbs.
Now, spring is here, the electricity is working and Kosova and 1-year-old Lisa are back home in their sun-drenched apartment.
“I don’t even remember this winter,” Kosova said. “It fades from the memory so quickly as if it never happened.”
Kyiv and its residents are bouncing back from the darkest winter of the war. Russia struck Ukraine’s energy infrastructure more than 1,400 times with missiles and drones dating to last July, according to an official Ukrainian tally. The attacks plunged cities into darkness and cut heat, leaving Kyiv residents such as Kosova and others in her apartment block on Tychyna Avenue freezing and miserable.

title: Capital social

title: Inside India’s suicide crisis, where metros lead in deaths of despair
content:
NEW DELHI: India’s major cities continue to show alarming signs of mental health strain and socio-economic distress, according to the National Crime Records Bureau (NCRB) 2024 data. The report highlights rising suicides, high crime rates, and growing emotional pressures across urban centres, with Delhi, Bengaluru, and Mumbai emerging as the most affected cities.
Delhi recorded the highest number of suicides among 53 Indian cities, while Bengaluru showed the highest suicide rate, and Mumbai remained among the top three cities despite a slight decline.
Delhi records highest suicides among 53 citiesDelhi reported 2,905 suicides in 2024, the highest among 53 Indian cities, according to NCRB data. Bengaluru followed with 2,403 suicides, while Mumbai recorded 1,406 cases. According to the NCRB report, Delhi recorded 2,905 suicides in 2024. Bengaluru followed with 2,403 suicides, while Mumbai reported 1,406 cases. In terms of suicide rate per lakh population, Bengaluru stood highest at 16.7, followed by Delhi at 13.2 and Mumbai at 11.
Although Delhi continued to top the list in absolute numbers, the city showed a gradual decline over the last three years.
The capital recorded 3,417 suicide deaths in 2022, 3,131 in 2023 and 2,905 in 2024. Despite the slight drop, the numbers remained significantly high, reflecting persistent emotional and socio-economic distress among residents. The suicide rates per lakh population were 13.2 in Delhi, 16.7 in Bengaluru and 11 in Mumbai.
Delhi, however, showed a gradual decline compared to previous years, recording 3,417 deaths in 2022, 3,131 deaths in 2023 and 2,905 deaths in 2024.
Who is most affected? Strong demographic patterns emergeThe NCRB data revealed clear demographic patterns in Delhi’s suicide cases. Out of the total 2,905 suicides, 2,078 victims were men, accounting for 71.5 per cent of all cases. Women accounted for 825 deaths, while two transgender persons were also among the victims.
The marital status data indicated that married individuals formed the largest category of suicide victims. A total of 1,616 married persons died by suicide, compared to 821 unmarried individuals. The report also recorded 27 widowed victims, 55 divorced persons and 41 separated individuals.
The figures showed that more than 55.6 per cent of the total victims in Delhi were married, suggesting a strong connection between domestic responsibilities, family stress and emotional pressure. Out of Delhi’s total suicides, 2,078 victims were men, 825 were women and two were transgender persons. The marital status breakdown showed 1,616 married victims, 821 unmarried victims, 27 widowed persons, 55 divorced persons and 41 separated individuals.
Leading causes: Family stress dominatesThe NCRB report identified family-related issues as the leading cause behind suicides in Delhi, accounting for 675 deaths. Marital problems were linked to 258 cases, while unemployment contributed to 236 deaths. The occupational profile of the victims reflected the widespread socio-economic pressures faced by different sections of society. The report showed that 745 victims were unemployed. Students accounted for 378 cases, daily wage workers for 343 cases, while 325 victims were self-employed, including 242 business owners. Homemakers accounted for 315 cases. The findings pointed towards emotional stress, academic burden, financial instability and livelihood insecurity as major contributing factors behind suicides.
Income and education trends show economic vulnerabilityThe income profile of the victims further highlighted economic vulnerability. A total of 1,362 victims earned less than Rs 1 lakh annually, while 1,258 victims belonged to the income group earning between Rs 1 lakh and Rs 5 lakh per year. Only 28 victims had annual incomes above Rs 10 lakh. Educational background data showed that suicides cut across all education levels. Among the victims, 537 had studied up to Class XII, 525 up to Class X and 383 up to Class VIII. The report also recorded 319 graduate victims and 310 individuals with no formal education. The income profile showed that 1,362 victims earned below Rs 1 lakh annually, while 1,258 earned between Rs 1 lakh and Rs 5 lakh annually. Only 28 victims earned above Rs 10 lakh annually. In terms of education, 537 victims had studied up to Class XII, 525 up to Class X and 383 up to Class VIII. The report also recorded 319 graduates and 310 persons with no formal education. This suggested that suicides were more concentrated among lower-income groups, though they cut across all education levels.
Crimes against women and children remain high in DelhiApart from suicides, the NCRB report also highlighted serious concerns related to women’s and children’s safety in Delhi.
The capital recorded 7,827 crimes against women involving 7,904 victims in 2024. Among these were 1,058 rape cases. Crimes against children also remained alarmingly high, with Delhi recording 7,662 such cases, compared to 3,374 in Mumbai and 2,026 in Bengaluru. In kidnapping and abduction cases, Delhi again topped the list with 5,404 cases. Mumbai reported 1,831 cases, while Bengaluru recorded 1,136 incidents.
Under the Protection of Children from Sexual Offences (POCSO) Act, Delhi registered 1,553 cases in 2024. Mumbai followed closely with 1,416 cases, while Bengaluru recorded 594 cases. The data reflected continuing concerns regarding the safety of women and children in urban areas, especially in the national capital. Women-related crimes in Delhi stood at 7,827 cases involving 7,904 victims, including 1,058 rape cases. Delhi also recorded 7,662 crimes against children, while Mumbai reported 3,374 cases and Bengaluru 2,026. In kidnapping and abduction cases, Delhi recorded 5,404 cases, Mumbai 1,831 and Bengaluru 1,136. Under POCSO, Delhi registered 1,553 cases, Mumbai 1,416 and Bengaluru 594.
Property crimes and road safety challenges in DelhiProperty-related crimes also remained high in Delhi. The city reported 39,976 vehicle theft cases, 10,690 household thefts, 8,968 burglary cases, 1,510 robberies and 228 extortion cases. Road safety emerged as another area of concern. Delhi recorded 1,521 road accidents in 2024, resulting in 1,658 deaths. The figures underlined the growing burden on policing systems, civic infrastructure and urban safety management.
Delhi continued to report high levels of property-related crime, including 39,976 vehicle thefts, 10,690 household thefts, 8,968 burglary cases, 1,510 robberies and 228 extortion cases. Road safety data showed 1,521 road accidents and 1,658 deaths linked to road accidents.
Bengaluru suicide trend: Steady rise over yearsBengaluru continued to witness a steady rise in suicides over the years. The city recorded 2,313 suicides in 2022, 2,370 in 2023 and 2,403 in 2024. Trend data for 2025 showed 2,364 cases. Between 2022 and November 2025, Bengaluru reported a total of 9,450 suicides, averaging nearly seven deaths every day. The NCRB data showed that hanging remained the most common method used in Bengaluru, accounting for 8,148 cases. Poison consumption was reported in 740 cases, while 204 people died after jumping from heights. The city recorded 2,313 suicides in 2022, 2,370 in 2023, 2,403 in 2024 and 2,364 cases in 2025, according to trend data. Methods used included hanging in 8,148 cases, poison consumption in 740 cases and jumping from heights in 204 cases.
Experts call it a psycho-social crisisMental health experts said suicides are being driven by emotional distress, lack of coping skills and increasing social pressure.
Dr Raveesh BN, professor and head of psychiatry at Mysuru Medical College and Research Institute, said: "It is a psycho-social problem,"
He further added: "Access to means is also an issue in deaths by suicide. Earlier, fans were fitted at a height that can't be reached easily. Earlier, pesticides and other materials were not easily available, unlike now,"
He also stated: "Various forms of stress continue to be the major reason for suicides. If individuals don't learn problem-solving skills, they are more vulnerable to taking extreme steps,"
Dr
Kiran R, senior resident at Tele MANAS, NIMHANS, said: "Family and relationship, academic, financial and adolescent issues are the major reasons for individuals taking such extreme steps,"
He further advised: "If one develops suicidal thoughts, they must call a helpline number immediately and seek professional help. They need to talk to close ones and move to a safer place immediately,"
Archana Kartik added: "Most of the phone calls received are from people between the ages of 18 and 45, due to issues like sleep, sadness, phobias, anxiety, marriage-related issues, financial difficulties, exam stress, grief, and suicidal ideation,"
She also noted: "When needed, the audio calls can be converted to video consultation through mental health professionals."
Mumbai and Maharashtra context (city-level focus)Mumbai recorded 1,406 suicides in 2024 and ranked third among 53 Indian cities. The suicide rate in Mumbai stood at 11 per lakh population.
In 2022 has recorded 1,501 suicides case, indicating a marginal decline by 2024. However, despite the drop, the city remained among the top three urban centres with the highest suicide burden in India.
At the state level, Maharashtra continued to contribute significantly to the country’s suicide numbers, driven by urban stress in Mumbai and wider socio-economic pressures across the state. Mumbai recorded 1,406 suicides in 2024, ranking third among 53 Indian cities, with a suicide rate of 11 per lakh population. The city had reported 1,501 suicides in 2022, showing a slight decline by 2024.
Telangana shows rising mental health-linked suicidesTelangana also reported rising suicides linked to mental illness. In 2024, the state recorded 951 such suicides and a suicide rate of 28.6 per cent, making it the fifth highest in the country. Among states, Karnataka recorded 2,465 suicides linked to mental illness, followed by Madhya Pradesh with 1,598, Tamil Nadu with 1,276, Maharashtra with 1,092 and Telangana with 951.
Experts pointed to unemployment, loneliness, academic pressure, financial instability and relationship issues as major triggers behind the growing crisis.
Dr Jawaharlal Nehru P said: “Many hesitate to discuss their emotions openly because of fear of judgment, which gradually pushes them into loneliness,”
Telangana recorded 951 suicides linked to mental illness and a suicide rate of 28.6 per cent, the fifth highest in India. Among states, Karnataka recorded 2,465 such cases, Madhya Pradesh 1,598, Tamil Nadu 1,276, Maharashtra 1,092 and Telangana 951.
A growing need for mental health supportNCRB data highlights urgent need for stronger intervention systems
The NCRB 2024 findings present a deeply concerning picture of India’s urban mental health and safety landscape. While Delhi continues to report the highest number of suicides, Bengaluru records the 2nd highest suicide rate and Mumbai remains among the top three cities despite a slight decline in cases. Across regions, family conflicts, financial stress, unemployment, academic pressure and emotional isolation continue to emerge as the most common triggers behind suicides. The data highlights the urgent need for stronger mental health infrastructure, accessible counselling systems, early intervention mechanisms and sustained public awareness efforts to address the growing psychological burden across India’s cities and states.

title: Kuo Ting-tsai and the media scrum - Taipei Times
content:
KMT lawmaker Kuo Ting-tsai (郭廷才) appeared in a Kaohsiung court on Tuesday to face charges of abuse of power relating to a park land rezoning scheme. As reported in the Taipei Times, reporters were not so much interested in Kuo's court appearance as in the chance to question him on the Tungkang Credit Cooperative (東港信用合作社) scandal, where he is alleged to have embezzled NT$2.3 billion. According to the report: "Since reporters had not had a chance to question Kuo about the Tungkang case, they crowded about him as he came out of the court.
"Kuo refused to answer any questions and punched at reporters on his way out of the court. Kou knocked down two photographers, sending their equipment scattering to the ground."
What actually happened was caught on film by the numerous news crews; one aired by TVBS was particularly unsettling.
As Kuo tried to leave the building, he was swarmed by at least 20 reporters and cameramen who encircled him and made it nearly impossible for him to pass. Unfortunately, for the reporters, Kuo was in no mood to talk. To make matters worse, Kuo soon found that what he had thought was an exit from the building was in fact a dead-end corridor. The segment shown by TVBS was pure theater: no commentary, just live feed from shouting reporters -- a frenzied mob hounding Kuo like a pack of wild dogs. Having tried to get away from what was clearly a relentless hoard, Kuo swung his arms wildly (but hardly in what anyone would call punches) and yelled at the reporters in the most commonly-heard Taiwanese oath.
The cameramen who fell did so because of their over zealousness -- they tripped over each other in their feeding frenzy to get the best picture, the best sound bite.
Then TVBS turned a pathetic incident into a bizarre one: they showed Kuo in slow motion, tossing a tangle of cables back at the news teams and swinging fruitlessly at his tormentors. The message here was easy to understand: We journalists were just trying to do our job, but this hard-headed, foul-mouthed bastard wouldn't let us.
This is not an isolated incident. Every day we see scenes that can only amaze a sensible viewer. Cameramen and reporters crowding into a police station to film the latest "suspect." The fact that a person may have been called to the station to provide information is irrelevant. For the camera crew, why would a person be in a police station unless they were guilty of a crime?
What TV news would be complete without shots of camera crews competing in a hospital emergency room for a close-up of someone's misfortune and suffering?
Journalists in Taiwan who follow the frenetic, cutthroat style of hounding a subject are not only rude and unprofessional, they do not provide the information that the public expects of them. Instead of getting something constructive out of Kuo Ting-tsai, it was the news crews that created the day's story. Instead of acting as an impartial observer, the news media, and television in particular, manipulate events -- knowingly or otherwise. Although this practice is unlikely to stop altogether, this confrontational, ambulance-chasing sort of journalism does nothing to educate the public or further the ideals of newsmen to provide unbiased coverage.
Mark Wolfe is an editor at the Taipei Times.

title: 花蓮縣總預算爭議延宕半年落幕 縣府：加速行政 | 政治 | 中央社 CNA
content:
花蓮縣總預算爭議延宕半年落幕 縣府：加速行政
（中央社記者李先鳳花蓮18日電）花蓮縣總預算爭議，內政部今天函復，認定預算案合法，同意全數通過。花蓮縣政府表示，雖延宕半年，將依法加速行政，堅守鄉親權益。議會表示尊重，未來持續嚴格監督預算執行。
花蓮縣115年度總預算案去年10月送縣議會，議會依程序委員會決議，要求縣府補充修正總預算案，未獲縣府同意而遲未排審；因已超過法定期限，為確保縣民權益，因此依地方制度法函請內政部核定。內政部表示，1個月協商期滿，原則尊重縣政府編列預算，按縣府編列數通過。至於雙方對馬太鞍溪堰塞湖洪災重建經費規劃等爭議，請議會安排縣長專案報告進行監督，並請縣政府妥善回應。
花蓮縣政府指出，115年度預算攸關基層建設、社福照顧及災後重建等各項施政經費，包括65歲健保補助、假牙補助、敬老愛心計程車補助調升，以及青年創業獎勵、婦幼照護等多項115年度新措施。縣府目前正依內政部核定結果完成後續法定預算程序，將在完成相關行政程序後，以最快速度推動辦理。
花蓮縣政府表示，始終秉持依法行政，堅守花蓮鄉親權益。縣長徐榛蔚高度重視馬太鞍災後復建工作，分別於114年10月31日上午、115年5月15日下午，兩度赴議會報告復建進度，並在議會監督下，讓災區早日恢復安定生活。
花蓮縣議會發表聲明表示，尊重內政部最終依法所作出的決定。對於115年度增加的總預算，呼籲花蓮縣政府應秉持審慎態度，善用納稅人的每一分錢，議會也將持續嚴格監督各項預算的執行情形。
花蓮縣議會強調，花蓮縣政府今年度握有高達新台幣401億元的史上最多預算經費，這都是全體納稅人的血汗錢。特別是在內政部函中所關切的「馬太鞍災後重建預算經費支應規劃」及「對所轄鄉（鎮、市）公所補助款分配」等均衡發展議題上，更需要公開透明，告知縣民如何照顧受災民眾及各鄉鎮市財源補助的公平性。
議會指出，將依內政部公文指示及地方制度法第49條第1項規定，擇日安排縣長徐榛蔚於開議期間率領相關局處首長進行專案報告。希望徐榛蔚及縣政府團隊能妥善回應、詳細說明相關規劃，讓重建經費真正用在刀口上，保障全體縣民的福祉與花蓮的永續發展。（編輯：李淑華）1150518

title: Best term insurance plan 2026 guide: 5 key factors to check before you buy | Mint
content:
In the current environment, opting for the best term insurance plan can be a critical financial decision. Making the right decision will help in securing your family’s long-term economic well-being and peace, even in your absence.
With rising inflation, evolving liabilities and lifestyle changes, a well-structured, well-thought-out term plan can ensure that your loved ones remain safe and protected against financial hiccups, even in the most challenging times.
Still, with several insurers offering similar-looking plans, the real challenge is to understand the difference before you invest in any plan.
Here are important factors to consider before proceeding with a term insurance plan in 2026.
Your term insurance plan must be large enough to replace your income and cover long-term economic responsibilities. A well-known practical benchmark is 10-15x of your annual income, adjusted for inflation, home loans, personal loans, children’s education expenses, daily household needs and spouse’s retirement requirements. Poor planning can lead to underinsurance, psychological stress and leave your family financially exposed.
For example, if your Cost to company (CTC) is ₹1 lakh per month, i.e., ₹12 lakh per year, a basic rule of thumb for a term cover is around 10-15x of your total annual salary. Therefore, your term insurance coverage should be about ₹1.2 crore to ₹1.8 crore.
CSR is another crucial metric that you should not ignore. It shows how reliable an insurer is in paying claims. A higher CSR generally indicates stronger trustworthiness, faith and transparency on the part of the insurer in repaying pending claims.
As an investor or term insurance purchaser, you should look for a CSR of over 95%. Consistent performance over multiple years, faster claim processing timelines and sincerity in clearing pending claims are key metrics that must be closely monitored before locking in on any policy offering. A good policy is only as strong as its claim settlement history.
The cheapest plan is not always the best. Focus on evaluating important aspects such as premium affordability and reasonability over the long term, coverage and benefits offered for the price, built-in riders and benefits, if any. How flexible is the company in premium payment modes?
A balanced plan permits investors to value without compromising protection. If there are any doubts, do not hesitate to discuss the issue with investment professionals and certified financial advisors.
Riders help boost your base policy features and provide additional financial protection. Some key riders that come with term insurance plans are accidental death benefit, critical illness, waiver of premium and permanent disability, among others.
These add-ons are extremely important to propel the appeal of the term insurance you have applied for. They must be given due attention and analysed carefully so that you can make the most of the policy you are applying for. These riders can hence help strengthen your financial safety net against unforeseen risks.
A reputable insurer will ensure seamless policy management and claim experience. Their central focus will be on customer satisfaction. Such an approach will be key to building their integrity and reputation, which is why you should proceed only with such insurers.
While deciding on this, you should check the insurer's financial stability, digital services, ease of access, flexibility to boost cover at different life stages, transparency in policy terms and the promptness of the insurer's customer support or grievance redressal platform.
Here are some popular term insurance plans.
Insurer | Popular Term Plan | Key Highlights |
|---|---|---|
| TATA AIA Life Insurance | Sampoorna Raksha Promise - LifeTime | High trust, strong insurer, simple pure protection plan |
| HDFC Life Insurance | Click 2 Protect Supreme Plus | Flexible coverage options, multiple payout structures, and strong customisation |
| ICICI Prudential Life Insurance | iProtect Smart Plus | Comprehensive protection with critical illness and accident benefits |
| SBI Life Insurance | Smart Shield Plus | Affordable premiums, flexible coverage options for young earners |
| Bajaj Life Insurance | Bajaj Life eTouch II | High coverage options, strong settlement ratio, with multiple benefit variants and riders |
Note: The above plan list is illustrative; it has been compiled from publicly available insurer offerings on Policybazaar. For the latest updates on the plans, refer to the official websites of the respective insurers.
A term insurance plan, hence, is not just a simple financial product. In fact, it is a long-term economic protection strategy for your family's future in case something unforeseen happens to you.
The real decision should be made after checking fundamentals such as adequate coverage, rider benefits, claim reliability, insurer honesty and strength.
Any final investment decision should be made only after due diligence and consultation with a certified health professional, a qualified wealth planner or a certified investment advisor.

Ministro del Interior de Ecuador anunció colaboración con Estados Unidos en investigaciones contra Alex Saab: 'Muchos deben estar nerviosos'
El funcionario John Reimberg aseguró que no cree que fuera solo el testaferro de Maduro y enfatizó que 'puede haberlo sido de otros políticos'.
En la tarde del domingo 17 de mayo, el ministro del Interior de Ecuador, John Reimberg, aseguró que su país ayudará en las investigaciones que adelantan los Estados Unidos contra el señalado testaferro del exdictador Nicolás Maduro, quien fue capturado por Estados Unidos el 3 de enero de este año.
El funcionario ecuatoriano aseguró que no cree que solo fuera testaferro del exdictador venezolano y aseguró que "muchos (políticos) deben estar ahora nerviosos" y pendientes de "dónde esconderse".
El ministro del Interior de Ecuador, John Reimberg, aseguró este domingo 17 de mayo que el país andino colaborará con Estados Unidos en las investigaciones que puedan abrirse a partir de la información que aporte el empresario colombiano Alex Saab, señalado como testaferro de Nicolás Maduro y deportado esta semana a territorio estadounidense.
"Estados Unidos sabe que vamos a colaborar en todas las investigaciones necesarias en Ecuador sobre quienes pudieron haber participado en esos hechos durante esas fechas", declaró Reimberg a la prensa.
El ministro sostuvo que espera que "lo que diga (Saab) en la extradición" se traduzca en información y paquetes de inteligencia para países como Ecuador y permita avanzar en posibles investigaciones vinculadas a sus operaciones en la región.
Reimberg afirmó además que no cree que Saab haya sido testaferro "solo de quien dicen", sino que "puede haberlo sido de otros políticos de otros países"; y recalcó que el gobierno venezolano de Nicolás Maduro trabajó "cogidito de la mano" con el de Rafael Correa (2007-2017).
Tras la deportación de Saab a Estados Unidos, añadió el ministro, "muchos deben estar ahora nerviosos" y pendientes de "dónde esconderse", porque "nada de esto va a quedar en impunidad".
Extradición de Alex Saab
Saab, que aterrizó el sábado 16 de mayo en un aeropuerto de Miami tras haber sido deportado por el Gobierno de Venezuela, es amigo personal de Maduro y lleva años acusado en Estados Unidos de haberse enriquecido de forma ilícita mediante contratos gubernamentales y de haber actuado como testaferro del líder chavista.
El caso de Alex Saab ya había tenido ramificaciones en Ecuador a través de Foglocons, una empresa fundada en Guayaquil, la ciudad más grande del país, a través de uno de sus socios, según un expediente de la Comisión de Fiscalización de la Asamblea Nacional (Parlamento) que investigó el caso en 2021, cuando estaba presidida por el excandidato presidencial asesinado durante un mitin de campaña en 2023, Fernando Villavicencio.
De acuerdo con esa investigación, Foglocons obtuvo en 2011 un contrato con el Gobierno venezolano para la construcción de viviendas y el material para ello se exportaba desde Ecuador mediante operaciones que resultaron ser falsas.
Estas transacciones se efectuaron a través del Sistema Unitario de Compensación Regional de Pagos (Sucre), un mecanismo de intercambio comercial impulsado por la Alianza Bolivariana para Las Américas (ALBA), lo que permitió canalizar millonarios flujos de dinero entre Ecuador y Venezuela.
La Fiscalía ecuatoriana investigó el caso en una primera etapa, pero el proceso fue anulado en 2016.
En 2021, la entonces fiscal general, Diana Salazar, denunció ante la Asamblea la "impunidad" con la que transitaron los responsables de Foglocons, y acusó a jueces del caso de haber favorecido esa situación.

title: Don\'t rely too heavily on foreign laborers - Taipei Times
content:
Within a period of just a few days, two group fights involving foreign laborers have taken place. These incidents indicate that increasing caution must be exercised in our foreign labor policy.
Over the past decade, the cost of labor in Taiwan has surged due to currency appreciation and competition by countries with even lower labor costs. As a result, many traditional labor-intensive products in Taiwan have lost their competitive edge. During the same period, the increase in average income, the popularity of speculative investments and changing attitudes have made people less willing to take hard or high-risk jobs. In view of the resulting labor shortage, businesses in Taiwan requested the introduction of foreign labor.
The management of foreign laborers easily gives rise to discontent, for foreign laborers came from afar and often have much bitterness and sorrow bottled up within them. There are tremendous possibilities for rivalry to develop between foreign laborers of different nationalities who have significantly different cultures and values. Cases in point include the recent conflict between groups of Filipino and Thai workers, and the military hostility that nearly erupted between the Philippines and Singapore over a Singapore court's conviction of a Filipino maid.
Taiwan's isolation in the international community complicates the management of disputes between foreign laborers. Some foreign laborers recognize this vulnerability and use it as an opportunity to seek personal gain.
Putting aside the danger of espionage activities and sabotage, the introduction of Chinese laborers into Taiwan presents a different set of alarming problems. China's militant disposition fostered by prolonged communist indoctrination and the political feud between the two sides of the Taiwan Strait, in and of themselves, give sufficient reasons for conflict to arise between Chinese laborers and laborers from other countries, leading perhaps even to conflict between governments. If these conflicts are not properly managed, not only would they disrupt cross-strait relations, they may even be used as an excuse by China to invade Taiwan.
It is, therefore, necessary to exercise extreme caution in bringing in foreign laborers to Taiwan. This is especially true in regard to laborers from China.
To solve the problem of labor shortages and higher wages, businesses and industries, instead of relying too heavily on foreign laborers, should strive to further automate and improve their work environments, as well as upgrade the quality and added values of their products.
Chen Po-chih is a professor of economics at National Taiwan University.

title: Social capital
content:
Social capital
Por capital social se entiende el conjunto de normas, instituciones y organizaciones que promueven la confianza y la cooperación entre las personas, en las comunidades y en la sociedad en su conjunto. En aquellas formulaciones del paradigma del capital social (y del neoinstitucionalismo económico en que éstas se basan en parte); que se concentran en sus manifestaciones colectivas, se plantea que las relaciones estables de confianza y cooperación pueden reducir los costos de transacción, producir bienes públicos y facilitar la constitución de actores sociales o incluso de sociedades civiles saludables

title: M5 closed in both directions for police incident
content:
M5 closed in both directions for police incident
A section of the M5 has been closed for several hours while police manage an incident.
The motorway was closed in both directions between junction 30 for Exeter and junction 31 for Okehampton at 03:50 BST.
Devon and Cornwall Police said multiple road diversions had been put in place and asked motorists to avoid the area and find alternative routes.
Officers added they would update the public as soon as the incident had been resolved.

title: India achieves milestone as first domestically produced C-295 aircraft is ready for flight test
content:
India’s first domestically produced C-295 transport aircraft has been assembled at the Tata-Airbus facility in Vadodara and is now preparing for its first flight test.
Air Marshal Awadhesh Kumar Bharti, Deputy Chief of the Air Staff, visited the final assembly line of the C-295 aircraft at Tata Advanced Systems Limited (TASL) in Vadodara to review progress.
IAF said in a post on X on Friday, "Deputy Chief of the Air Staff visited the final assembly line of the C-295 at Tata Advanced Systems Limited (TASL), Vadodara, where the first C-295 under the Make in India initiative is getting ready for its first flight. The programme, executed in partnership between TASL and Airbus, represents a major advancement in indigenous aerospace manufacturing and is a significant step towards Atmanirbhar Bharat."
India signed a Rs 21,935 crore contract with Spain for 56 C-295 transport aircraft, with 16 being delivered in fly-away condition and the remaining 40 set to be manufactured in India.
The Tata-Airbus manufacturing plant in Vadodara was inaugurated on October 28, 2024, by Prime Minister Narendra Modi and Spanish Prime Minister Pedro Sánchez.
The C-295 aircraft will replace the aging Avro-748 fleet of the Indian Air Force and will be used for troop transport, cargo movement, medical evacuation and special operations missions.
Powered by two Pratt & Whitney PW127G turboprop engines, the C-295 features short take-off and landing capabilities and can operate from rugged and semi-prepared airstrips. Each aircraft will also be fitted with an indigenous electronic warfare suite developed jointly by Defence Research and Development Organisation, Bharat Electronics Limited and Bharat Dynamics Limited.

title: 張乙安雙響砲後援飆速148 王貞治盃新北晉4強 | 運動 | 中央社 CNA
content:
張乙安雙響砲後援飆速148 王貞治盃新北晉4強
（中央社記者謝靜雯新北18日電）王貞治盃青棒賽新北市隊與嘉義縣今天交手，新北市隊張乙安投打有表現，單場雙響砲，後援投1.2局無失分，飆速148公里，助隊以16比10搶勝，晉級4強。
115年大甲媽祖盃王貞治青棒賽A組勝部冠軍戰新北市今天與嘉義縣交手，新北市開賽就有大局，1局下靠著接連安打、四死球保送、滾地球先拿3分，帕蘇拉．塔基斯利尼安敲出2分砲，幫助球隊取得5比0領先。
嘉義縣2局上追2分，新北市2局下張乙安敲出陽春砲，2人出局後靠著接連2支安打再添1分，3局下靠著接連四壞保送、失誤，一口氣跑回2分，再靠著高飛犧牲打送回第10分。
5局上戰況有變，嘉義縣隊一口氣打了11人次，單局敲出6支安打，選到2次四壞保送，吳文傑單局2個打席都敲出安打，包括1發追平比數3分砲，將比數追至10比10平手。
新北市隊5局下再起攻勢，靠著觸身球保送，1人出局後接連4支安打攻勢串聯，攻下4分、要回領先，6局下張乙安敲個人單場第2轟，陽春砲替球隊多添保險分，再靠著滿壘觸身球保送擠回分數。
透過 Google News追蹤中央社
張乙安今天先發打第2棒、守游擊，1局選到四壞保送上壘，2局、6局都開轟，單場2轟貢獻2分打點，目前賽會累計敲出3轟。
6局上嘉義縣進攻，1人出局、壘上有人局面，張乙安接手後援，凍結對手攻勢，7局再賞對手3上3下，替球隊守住勝利，總計投1.2局沒被敲出安打，投出3次三振，無失分，最快球速約148公里、拿下救援成功。（編輯：蕭博文）1150518

title: Compromiso
content:
Muchos padres tuvieron que acelerar el proceso de ser adultos y hacer varias cosas al mismo tiempo para poder cumplir con lo que se les exigía. Algunos se graduaron de la universidad mientras compraban su primera casa o carro y empezaban a tener familia, llenándose de deudas que podían adquirir porque el mercado laboral era diferente. Con el ánimo de no repetir la historia y de que nosotros, como generación, tuviéramos una mejor vida, nos incitaron a estudiar mucho más que ellos en menos tiempo, pero al enfrentarnos a un mundo laboral constreñido, fuimos entregados a tener tiempo libre, hambre del mundo y de las experiencias, pero un nulo sentido de compromiso, estabilidad y dificultad.
Nos mintieron con la idea de que teníamos que formarnos y buscar trabajo en algo que nos gustara para que no sintiéramos que teníamos que trabajar, pero olvidaron mencionar que muchos de ellos lograron su éxito al reconocer que el sentido no lo da el trabajo, sino que lo pone uno. Algunos tuvieron que asumir trabajos que no les gustaban y permanecieron en ellos, por las deudas o las obligaciones, hasta que crecieron en esos mismos lugares o perfeccionaron su perfil.
Hoy, los jóvenes no estamos dispuestos a hacer ese sacrificio. Muchos creen que con cursar una carrera deberían abrirles las puertas a la dirección de la empresa. Sin embargo, la mayor queja de los empleadores es la alta rotación de los ‘millennials’ y ‘centennials’, lo que ha hecho que algunas empresas hayan corrido a adaptarse creyendo que flexibilizar sus horarios o sus modalidades generaría la motivación necesaria para que permanecieran. Nuestra generación aún se cree infinita y pasajera; nos cuesta reconocer que cada trabajo es una oportunidad de aprendizaje o de ofrecer lo mejor que tenemos por dar, independiente de si se alinea o no con nuestros sueños de vida.
Lo mismo nos sucede en otras dimensiones de la vida. No apostamos por tener una casa propia porque tener una deuda por tanto tiempo es perdernos la posibilidad de vivir, como nuestros padres. En las parejas, son muy pocos los que optan por tener parejas cerradas o monogámicas, porque el otro casi siempre es imperfecto y no se ajusta a mí. En lo político, pasa algo curioso: nos comprometemos rápidamente con las causas globales que implican poca acción directa y nos aburren las necesidades del contexto inmediato. Si aterrizamos el tema a la próxima contienda electoral, podrán ver que muchos jóvenes están poco comprometidos en entender los programas de gobierno o soñar un futuro para el país, se suben a narrativas y comulgan en ellas como si fueran una moda cualquiera.
Muchos hemos desistido de la idea de un cambio porque seguimos con el ego herido, ya que el estallido social no fue más que una estrategia política e infiltración guerrillera que se apropió, silenció y opacó nuestros anhelos de una Colombia distinta. Pero, lejos de comprometernos más con ese futuro, nos hemos dejado llevar por la desesperanza y hemos inflado a ciertos candidatos por el fanatismo que genera la reverberación de consignas o, en el otro extremo, por tener un patriotismo que, si bien parece el compromiso que nos hace falta, se enuncia vacío. De hecho, si quisiera ser más crudo, diría que el éxito está en que ambas contiendas le hablan directamente a mi generación: espectáculo, burbuja y vacuidad carente de sentido.
Muchos jóvenes están poco comprometidos en entender los programas de gobierno o soñar un futuro para el país, se suben a narrativas y comulgan en ellas como si fueran una moda cualquiera
Creo aún en que mi generación puede dar la sorpresa en las elecciones, pero lo que requerimos es un cambio más profundo en el compromiso con el país. ¿Cuántos proyectos han pensado que pueden mejorar el trabajo en el que están antes de renunciar? ¿Cuántas soluciones tienen en mente para los problemas de su familia, de la comunidad y de las ciudades que habitan? ¿Qué tanto estamos esperando a que el mundo se adapte sin atrevernos a proponer? Hacerse esas preguntas es tal vez el grado más alto de compromiso.
ALEJANDRO HIGUERA SOTOMAYOR

title: U.S. Forces Kill About 20 Islamic State Fighters in Nigeria | Mint
content:
U.S. forces killed an estimated 20 Islamic State militants in a hotly contested corner of Nigeria, days after an operation that killed the group’s No. 2, U.S. and Nigerian officials said Monday.
The U.S. airstrikes, near the northeastern village of Metele, were the result of close intelligence sharing between the Nigerian and American militaries, according to officials.
“Terrorists who threaten our citizens, communities and national stability will be located and defeated,” Maj. Gen. Samaila Uba, a Nigerian military spokesman, said. “There will be no safe haven for terrorists anywhere in Nigeria.”
Relations between the U.S. and Nigeria, a powerhouse in West Africa, frayed last year when President Trump accused the Abuja government of failing to protect Christians from Islamist militants.
Since then, Nigeria has allowed hundreds of American troops to be posted to the country to train Nigerian forces and coordinate targeting of militant groups that have rampaged through the Lake Chad Basin for years. The U.S. has greater air capabilities than Nigeria, and has conducted the actual strikes.
“The removal of these terrorists diminishes the group’s capacity to plan attacks that threaten the safety and security of the U.S. and our partners,” U.S. Africa Command said Monday.
U.S. officials said no American or Nigerian troops were injured in the latest operation, which took place on Sunday.
On Friday, Trump announced that a joint operation in Nigeria had killed Islamic State’s No. 2, Nigeria-born Abu Bakr ibn Muhammad ibn ‘Ali al-Mainuki.
The U.N. estimates 8,000 to 12,000 Islamic State fighters operate in West Africa, which has become a global center of Islamist militancy.

Penerbit juga memastikan revisi itu akan diterapkan pada cetakan berikutnya.
Sementara untuk pembeli edisi pertama, mereka akan mendapatkan file PDF koreksi serta stiker revisi fisik yang dapat ditempel langsung pada buku naskah.
Permintaan stiker revisi nantinya akan dilakukan melalui Google Form yang dibuka mulai 18 Mei selama sekitar dua minggu.
Selain itu, pembeli juga dapat mengajukan pengembalian dana sesuai kebijakan masing-masing toko.

Kontroversi bermula dari adegan penobatan Grand Prince Ian yang diperankan Byeon Woo Seok.
Dalam adegan tersebut, karakter menggunakan istilah “Cheonse” yang secara historis identik dengan negara bawahan, bukan “Manse” yang melambangkan negara berdaulat dan independen.
Tak hanya itu, karakter Ian juga terlihat mengenakan mahkota sembilan untaian yang biasanya dipakai pejabat kerajaan, bukan mahkota kekaisaran dengan dua belas untaian.

Drama tersebut juga menuai kritik karena latar alternate history yang dianggap terlalu menyederhanakan sejarah Korea.
Beberapa peristiwa besar seperti masa penjajahan Jepang dan Perang Korea disebut dihilangkan dari dunia cerita drama tersebut.

Menanggapi kontroversi itu, tim produksi menyampaikan permintaan maaf.
Mereka mengakui bahwa meski drama tersebut mengusung kisah romansa alternate history, proses pengembangan dunia fiksi dan unsur sejarah seharusnya ditelaah lebih hati-hati.
Pihak produksi juga menyebut mereka kurang mendalami detail dalam menyempurnakan latar dunia fiksi yang digunakan dalam cerita 21st Century Grand Prince's Wife.

title: 台湾総統、台湾は紛争を挑発しないが主権は手放さないと トランプ氏の警告受け - BBCニュース
content:
台湾総統、台湾は紛争を挑発しないが主権は手放さないと トランプ氏の警告受け
台湾の頼清徳総統は17日、台湾は「主権を持つ独立した民主主義国」で、「どのような圧力を受けても国の主権と尊厳、そして民主的で自由な生活を手放しはしない」とフェイスブックに書いた。米中首脳会談後にドナルド・トランプ米大統領が台湾について、中国からの独立を自分は望んではいないと発言したことを受けてのもの。
頼総統はフェイスブックに、「『台湾独立』問題などない」と書き、今回のトランプ氏の発言に初めて反応した。「台湾、中華民国は、主権を持つ独立した民主主義国」であり、「台湾の未来はすべての台湾人の意思に従わなくてはならない」と強調した。
総統は、「台湾は紛争を挑発したり悪化させたりしないが、どのような圧力を受けても国の主権と尊厳、そして民主的で自由な生活を手放しはしない」と書いたほか、「台湾は海峡の両側での現状を常にしっかりと守ってきた。その現状を変更しようとしたことはない」と主張した。
さらに、台湾は「平等と尊厳という前提のもと、中国との健全で秩序のとれたやりとりや対話を推進」していきたいとも書きつつ、台湾を強制的に対話に引き込む口実に中国が「統一」を持ち出そうとする動きは受け入れられないとした。
これに先立ち台湾総統府の郭雅慧報道官は16日、台湾が「主権を持つ独立した民主主義国」であることは「自明だ」と声明で述べた。
一方で報道官は、台湾の頼清徳総統が常に、中国との現状維持を重視してきたとも述指摘した。
台湾の頼総統はかつて、台湾はすでに主権国だと自認しているため、正式な独立宣言は必要ないと発言している。
多くの台湾人は、自分たちを中国とは別の国の一員とみなしている。ただ、その大半は、中国からの独立も、中国との統一も宣言しない「現状維持」を望んでいる。
報道官は16日の声明でさらに、「トランプ大統領が第1期政権以来、台湾海峡の安全保障を支持し続けていることに、我が国は感謝している」と述べた。
そのうえで、「台湾は力による平和の実現のため、アメリカとの協力を一層深化させ、台湾海峡の平和と安定が脅かされたり損われたりしないよう取り組む。これは台湾、アメリカ、そして世界の民主主義社会にとって、共通の利益になることだ」と述べた。
中国国営メディアによると、習主席は首脳会談でトランプ氏に、「台湾問題は中米関係の最重要課題」で、「対応を誤れば、両国が衝突、さらには紛争に至る可能性もある」と警告したとされる。
トランプ氏は北京での2日間にわたる首脳会談を経て、米FOXニュースに対し、自分は台湾に関して「いずれの立場にも」コミットしていないと述べた。
トランプ氏は「何も変わっていない。これは言っておく。私は、誰かに独立してほしいとは思っていない。我々は戦争するために、9500マイル（約1万5300キロ）も移動することになっている。私はそんなことは望んでいない。彼ら（台湾）に冷静になってほしい。中国に冷静になってほしい」と話した。
中国は台湾を、自国の領土の一部だとし、統一のために武力を行使することを排除していない。
トランプ政権は昨年、台湾への110億ドル（約1兆7000億円）相当の武器売却を発表。これには高性能ロケット発射装置や様々なミサイルが含まれる。中国は当時これを非難した。
トランプ氏はこの売却について今回の首脳会談後にFOXニュースに聞かれると、「やるかもしれないし、やらないかもしれない」と答えた。
さらに、「こちらは戦争をしたいとは思っていないし、今のままにしておけば、中国はそれでOKだと思う。『アメリカが支援してくれるから独立しよう』なんて誰かが言うことは、望んでいない」とも述べた。
アメリカは法律により台湾に自衛手段を提供する義務を負っているものの、中国との外交関係維持との両立を常に図ってきた。
中国政府との関係を維持するには、「中国の政府は一つしか存在しない」という原則を受け入れることが前提になるため、米政府は以前から、台湾の独立を支持しないという立場をとっている。
中国から米ワシントンへ戻る大統領専用機内で、トランプ氏は記者団に対し、台湾について習主席と「たくさん」話をしたと述べた。しかし、アメリカが台湾を防衛するかどうかについては、言及を避けたという。
習氏は台湾について「とても強い思い」を持っており、「独立への動きを見たくないと思っている」のだとも、トランプ氏は述べた。
中国政府はかねて、台湾の頼総統を「トラブルメーカー」や「（台湾）海峡の両岸の平和の破壊者」などと呼び、公然と嫌悪感を示している。
中国は近年、台湾島周辺での軍事演習を強化している。これによって地域の緊張は高まり、アメリカが築いてきた均衡が試されている。
トランプ氏は記者団に、台湾への武器供与について台湾指導部と協議すると言い、「あなた方も知っている、現在台湾を率いている人物と、話をする必要がある」とも述べた。
アメリカは台湾と正式な外交関係はないが、実質的な非公式な関係を維持している。米大統領は台湾総統と直接協議しないことが慣例となっている。仮に総統との直接協議が行われれば、頼氏を分離主義者とみなす中国政府との間に大きな緊張が生じる可能性が高い。

title: La República contra el caudillo
content:
Montesquieu entendió una verdad elemental de toda democracia: cuando la justicia deja de ser independiente, el poder deja de tener límites. No hay separación de poderes sin jueces libres. No hay libertad política cuando el gobernante puede intimidar, someter o reemplazar a quienes deben controlarlo. Las naciones empiezan a derrumbarse cuando se destruye la justicia.
Durante casi cuatro años de desgobierno, la Rama Judicial ha sido el principal muro de contención frente a los excesos del poder presidencial. Si el país no ha derivado hacia un modelo abiertamente autoritario, ha sido porque los jueces han impedido que el Ejecutivo gobierne mediante estados de excepción injustificados, sustituya al Congreso con decretos o utilice mecanismos populistas para concentrar poder político y electoral.
Y precisamente por eso Petro ha convertido a la justicia en su principal enemigo. La más reciente arremetida ocurrió tras la suspensión provisional del Decreto 0415 de 2026 por parte del Consejo de Estado. Con ese decreto, el Gobierno pretendía trasladar obligatoriamente los ahorros pensionales de millones de colombianos desde los fondos privados hacia Colpensiones, afectando gravemente el régimen de ahorro individual. La respuesta presidencial no fue jurídica. Fue una amenaza directa contra el magistrado ponente, a quien acusó públicamente de cometer prevaricato y de actuar contra “el interés general”.
El mensaje es peligroso: cuando un presidente empieza a señalar a jueces como criminales por fallar en su contra, deja de entender la justicia como un contrapeso democrático y comienza a verla como un obstáculo político.
Pero el ataque no es aislado. Petro también ha acusado al Consejo de Estado de cometer “delitos” por permitir investigaciones electorales en su contra. Paralelamente, se conocieron denuncias sobre informes elaborados desde la Uiaf contra la magistrada Cristina Lombana, posteriormente filtrados para alimentar campañas de desprestigio. El patrón es evidente: intimidar, desacreditar y erosionar la legitimidad de los jueces.
La historia latinoamericana demuestra que todos los proyectos autoritarios siguen el mismo libreto. Primero desacreditan la justicia. Después la intimidan. Luego cambian las reglas institucionales para capturarla políticamente. Finalmente, convierten los tribunales en instrumentos del poder.
Chávez lo hizo mediante una constituyente que terminó destruyendo la separación de poderes. Evo Morales y Rafael Correa recorrieron caminos similares. Ningún caudillo tolera una justicia autónoma porque sabe que el único rival real del poder absoluto son los jueces independientes.
Cuando un presidente empieza a señalar a jueces como criminales por fallar en su contra, deja de entender la justicia como un contrapeso democrático y comienza a verla como un obstáculo político
Tocqueville lo entendió con claridad: “La tiranía de la mayoría es el mayor peligro de las democracias”. El populismo moderno utiliza la legitimidad popular para desmontar las instituciones que limitan el poder. Ya no necesita golpes militares ni tanques en las calles. Le basta con destruir gradualmente la confianza en la justicia.
Colombia conoce muy bien las consecuencias de atacar sus instituciones. La toma del Palacio de Justicia en 1985 simbolizó el intento violento de destruir una Rama Judicial incómoda. Cuatro décadas después, el riesgo es distinto, pero igual de grave: destruir la justicia desde el propio poder, mediante el desprestigio, la presión política y la captura institucional.
Y el país debería entender lo que está en juego. Si Colombia aún conserva estabilidad democrática, controles institucionales y una economía funcional, es precisamente porque todavía existen cortes capaces de frenar los excesos del poder. Sin esa resistencia institucional, el país estaría mucho más cerca de la devastación que sufrieron otras naciones latinoamericanas: corrupción estructural, hiperinflación, destrucción económica y ruptura de la paz social.
Porque cuando cae la justicia, lo que cae después es la República.
LUIS FELIPE HENAO CARDONA

title: 黃天賜有感職棒「沒這麼簡單」 增重提升身體素質 | 運動 | 中央社 CNA
content:
黃天賜有感職棒「沒這麼簡單」 增重提升身體素質
（中央社記者謝靜雯台北18日電）中職統一7-ELEVEn獅隊野手黃天賜三級棒球時期國際賽資歷豐富，展開職棒生涯有感「沒這麼簡單」，觀念和身體素質都要提升，增重約7公斤變更壯，目標增加至80公斤。
黃天賜今天出席華南金控盃全國少棒、青少棒賽事記者會，此賽事為今年亞洲少棒錦標賽、U15世界盃棒球賽國手選拔賽，黃天賜三級棒球階段都有國手資歷，在少棒、青少棒國際賽都有拿下個人獎。
黃天賜去年在中職選秀會中第5輪被獅隊選進，去年有在二軍出賽1場，今年目前為止二軍總計18場出賽，共49打數敲出9支安打，打擊率1成84。
黃天賜自評目前為止今年賽季表現算「還及格」，但沒有到特別好，加入職棒之後，發現職棒沒有這麼簡單，與陣中學長無論在經驗、各方面都差滿多的，還需要更努力。
透過 Google News追蹤中央社
進到獅隊後專職練游擊守位，黃天賜表示，技術上目前為止沒有太大的調整，教練團提醒比較多的都是觀念，也希望強化身體素質，讓長打、擊球力量提升。
黃天賜計畫性增重，他表示，跟著球隊重量訓練課表走，剛加入職棒體重約70公斤，目前增加至約77公斤，目標增重至80公斤，職棒強度和難度都更高，增重強化身體素質，也可以保護身體不容易受傷，隨著身體素質提升，相信力量和技術也會跟著成長。（編輯：張雅淨）1150518
